Subject: Venue overbook + exhibitor load-in window update

Hi Soojin / Ben — quick heads up from the venue operations team. We just got an updated load-in schedule from GreenStage: the loading dock is now restricted between 08:00–10:00 on Thursday (day 0) for freight they didn’t anticipate. That pushes exhibitor arrival windows and the early setup shift.

Practical impact for Redwood booth: our AM setup crew (3 people scheduled 07:30–11:30) will need to move to a 10:00–14:00 window OR we can keep two people early (to handle AV and crate tags) and move one person to afternoon. Also — Hyatt (our room block) flagged that they may overbook and have limited early check-in on Friday.

Can you confirm: 1) who can flex to a later shift or start the day later, 2) whether flights can be rebooked if someone needs to arrive a day earlier, and 3) if you need the alternate hotel shuttle info (we can hold 6 rooms at the Clarion as backup).

Attaching venue-loadin-instructions.pdf from GreenStage with the dock map and restricted windows.

Let me know ASAP so I can lock vendor staffing and communicate to the freight team.

Thanks,
Alyssa Hart
Event Manager — SummitCo Events
alyssa.h@summitco.io
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

2) Flights: if someone needs an earlier arrival (Thursday night) we have a $450 rebooking cap on the team card — Ben, can you check fares and hold if needed?

3) Hotels: please confirm Clarion backup hold (6 rooms) with shuttle times. Marissa, can you take ownership of communicating room moves to the group if Hyatt asks to bump early check-ins?

I’ll notify CS about coverage for the product demo at 11:00 if we lose an AM person.

So — action items: Ben (check flights + confirm rebook cap), Marissa (confirm Clarion holds + update team), Vivek (approve shift swap for Lee).
